semantics.how: Turns each function's block graph into block units parented under that function, naming them from labels, and emits control_flow edges with branch labels
semantics.what: Builds the block units and control_flow edges behind the Flowchart view
semantics.when: Called by every pipeline and zero-LLM merge path
semantics.why: Blocks are pure AST structure so they need no LLM context

semantics.how: Recovers each label from the block name, the outgoing edge label and the provenance source
semantics.what: Reads labels back out of already-built block units
semantics.when: Called by merges that change only unit semantics
semantics.why: Preserves existing block labels without a pending file
